articles.title: QodFlow – a Kanban board AI agents can drive via MCP
articles.summary: Hi HN. We built QodFlow because we wanted a kanban board our AI agents could work directly — not a chatbot bolted onto the sidebar.It exposes an MCP server. An agent connects with a scoped, revocable token and can: claim_job, report_progress, attach_evidence, request_human_decision, resolve_decision. Every call writes to the same job timeline humans see, tagged human vs agent, so there's one audit trail of who (or what) did what. When an agent hits something irreversible it opens a request_human
